reviews.author: Wendy

reviews.title: A handy game both can be enjoyed by the Young and Old
reviews.body: Bought this game as soon as it was released as a gift for me and sort of to rekindle my childhood.Nothing's changed about the game settings and how the games are played. It takes a while to master it after years of absence for me.For its 35th Anniversary release, I would have expected something a little different. When it came, I was rather disappointed by how light it is and small for adult's hands. (Maybe I have forgotten how it was like LoL) My daughter who is 11 years old, enjoys playing it very much and fares better than me.  Overall,  it is still a game that I enjoy playing and provides entertainment,  without the fuss of consoles and big screens. I can carry it anywhere with me as it is small, especially when I am out with my family.
reviews.author: LoveShoes

features: Play Super Mario Bros. – Game & Watch style! - Jump over bottomless pits, stomp Goombas and enter Warp Pipes just as you remember – but with even tighter controls thanks to the system's +Control Pad.
Even more Mario! - Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels comes packed in, but if you're wanting a more casual experience, then Ball (with extra Super Mario flair!) should tickle that fancy
Time for fun - As time passes, the included digital clock may play 35 different animations – including some guest appearances from Mario's friends and foes!
